name: Underground Assault
summary: Shoni the Shilent sends Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to seize a power core. The exiled gnomes need it to drive drills through the rock around Gnomeregan and reclaim their home.

sections.title: A Desperate Ingenuity
sections.body: Gnomish tinkerers fled across Khaz Modan and Stormwind after primitive troggs brought Gnomeregan down. Shoni the Shilent is already planning how to break through the rock around their lost home. Her gyrodrillmatic excavationators need great power to bore through the underground stone. Human lands have no local power grids, so the gnomes have turned to heavy goblin machinery in the criminal underworld.

sections.title: Looting the Defias Foundries
sections.body: In the Deadmines shafts in Westfall, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood employs goblin engineers to build war machines. One machine is a working goblin shredder, a lumbering automaton. Shoni sends Alliance operatives to destroy or dismantle it and recover its specialized heart, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket. The exiled gnomes need that goblin power supply to drive their drills through the underground rock and begin their counteroffensive to reclaim Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Who gives the Underground Assault quest?
faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent, a gnomish engineer in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, sends you. Other gnomes often direct adventurers to her after speaking of her ambitious plans.

faq.q: Where do I find the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket?
faq.answer: You recover the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines foundry tunnels in Westfall.

faq.q: Why does Shoni need parts from a goblin shredder?
faq.answer: Gnomish gyrodrillmatic excavationators need great portable power to break through the reinforced underground borders around Gnomeregan. The heavy-duty core powering the Defias goblin shredder provides the mechanical force those drills require.

faq.q: What is the broader goal of this mission?
faq.answer: The exiled gnomes plan to power heavy excavation drills, tunnel through the rocky perimeter of captured Gnomeregan, and launch a surprise assault against the troggs occupying it.

faq.q: What happened to Gnomeregan that caused this assault to be planned?
faq.answer: A subterranean trogg invasion rose from deep beneath Gnomeregan and overwhelmed the city. Toxic radiation contaminated it during the chaotic defense, forcing survivors to flee as refugees to Ironforge and Stormwind.

faq.q: Are the Defias Brotherhood and the troggs allied?
faq.answer: No, the Defias Brotherhood and the troggs have no connection. The Defias hired goblin tinkerers to build war machines in Westfall, and Shoni uses their Deadmines foundry as a source of powerful goblin technology.

angles.text: As an exiled gnomish adventurer, you help salvage a power core for drills that can break through the rocky walls of your fallen home and help drive the troggs from Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the bold plan to take a goblin shredder's power core and fuel precise gnomish excavation machinery.
As an Alliance adventurer, you strengthen Stormwind's bond with its displaced gnomish allies and strike at the Defias supply line.
